text:
samira (Design): quick design review — Private setup preflight. want to nail the UX/copy for the connectivity checks (SSH probe + egress tests). users are confused by the current wording "we will attempt to SSH" and some asked if this opens ports. thoughts?

lee (UX): +1, wording is scary. suggest an explicit toggle: `Run connectivity checks (recommended)` with a short explainer. keyboard/focus: when a check fails, focus should move to the failing input and SR should announce the failure. :eyes:

jonathan (Eng): fwiw our probe does: SSH -> HTTP -> raw TCP in that order. it originates from our health-checker IP range (will add list). it does not perform auth, just attempts a TCP handshake. we should be clear about that to reduce security questions. also current probe is IPv4-only — need to call that out for IPv6-only environments.

samira (Design): nice. can we show which probe ran in the failure state? e.g. an inline pill `SSH check failed` so users know what to fix. also prefer "connectivity checks" rather than "network tests" in UI copy.

maya (Product): small policy note: default the toggle ON for hosted accounts and OFF for private/on-prem by default (opt-in) so customers behind stricter policies must enable. also avoid the term "allowlist" — use "allow list" or "permitted IPs".

lee (UX): Accessibility nit: the toggle needs an accessible label that includes what will be contacted and the fact that no credentials are used. sample aria text: "Run connectivity checks. Checks will attempt a TCP handshake from Redwood health-checker IPs. No credentials are sent."

samira (Design): proposing microcopy (copy suggestions below). please critique/shorten.

---
Proposed microcopy (short):

`Run connectivity checks (recommended)`
`We'll attempt a connection from Redwood's health-checker IPs to the host and port you provide. No credentials are used. If you'd rather not run checks, uncheck this box.`

Error variant (inline):
`SSH check failed — connection to bastion.example.com:22 timed out. Confirm egress rules and that connections from Redwood health-checker IPs are permitted. [Show logs]`

Success pill: `Connectivity checks passed` (green)

---

jonathan (Eng): those are fine. one implementation caveat: logs may include IPs and the target host; we should avoid logging keys or user-provided secrets. also for on-prem with strict egress we can offer a "download probe script" fallback: users run a one-shot script inside their network that posts back results to a signed URL. that avoids opening our IPs.

maya (Product): +1 to the script fallback. add a short CTA: `Run checks for me (recommended)` and `Run checks locally (manual)` to clarify.

lee (UX): about keyboard flow — when user presses enter on the toggle it should run the check and send focus to a status region. SR should read either `Connectivity checks running` or `Connectivity checks passed/failed` with suggested next step. use `role=status` or live region polite.

samira (Design): quick UX ask: show an itemized checklist of prereqs above the form (eg. `Outbound egress allowed to Redwood health-checker IPs`, `Bastion host reachable on port 22`, `Optional: HTTP port 80/443 open for health endpoints`). that reduces cognitive load.

jonathan (Eng): i'll add a small API flag `probe_mode` (hosted|manual) so frontend knows which CTAs to show. also will return `probe_details` array so UI can render `SSH`, `HTTP`, `TCP` pills with statuses.

maya (Product): copy tweak: instead of "We will attempt to connect from X", use "Redwood will attempt a connection from its health-checker IPs to the host and port you supply." short + explicit.

samira (Design): +1. final ask before I mock: can someone write a short privacy blurb we can link to? suggested line under the toggle: `We only attempt connections from our health-checker IPs and do not send credentials. See privacy details.` link to doc.

jonathan (Eng): i'll draft the privacy blurb and post a link by EOD.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled for staging at 2025-11-12T02:00Z (just FYI) :gear:

maya (Product): OK — i'll update the product spec with these toggles + CTAs + fallbacks. Thanks all :thumbsup:

samira (Design): thanks — i'll push a mock to Figma and ping when ready.
